<thought>We assume the target molecule for the Doebner modification is cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). We'll search the template catalog for a template that breaks an aldehyde and an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms a C‑C double bond, which should correspond to the Doebner modification.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
